citation: Saner NJ, et al. 2021. Exercise mitigates sleep-loss-induced changes in glucose tolerance, mitochondrial function, sarcoplasmic protein synthesis, and diurnal rhythms. Molecular Metabolism 43:101110.
protocol: 2 baseline nights 8 h in bed (23:00-07:00), then 5 nights of 8 h (NS) or 4 h in bed (SR, SR+EX); OGTT after intervention, 75 g glucose in 300 ml at 08:00 after overnight fast
population: n=24 healthy young males (8 per group), age 24 +/- 4 (NS), 25 +/- 5 (SR), 24 +/- 4 (SR+EX) y

reports.where: Results text, OGTT glucose AUC pre and post (mean +/- SD), group mean change and 95% CI

note: Glucose AUC rather than point values; the time curves are figures. Insulin not printed in the text extract. Participant table is mean +/- SD.
